acceptanceCriteria.description: On load, Periodic Maintenance is selected by default and existing (non-deleted) inspection and contact records are displayed.
Selecting a different Activity Type radio warns about unsaved changes before switching.
Add Row creates a new editable inspection row with Status = ADD; Repair/Inspection Code is selectable and Description auto-populates on selection.
Deleting an inspection or contact row marks it Status = DEL and hides it from the grid; it is removed from the backend on Save.
Checking Mandatory on an existing inspection row changes its Status to UPD.
Contact Process is limited to Service Follow-up; Channel is limited to Call, Email, SMS.
Activity Day accepts numeric values only, max 2 digits, within -30 to 30; invalid entry shows an inline error.

Save is blocked (with a validation message) unless at least one inspection item and at least one contact process record are configured, all mandatory fields are filled, and no duplicate Contact Process + Channel combination exists.
Save prompts for confirmation, then on success shows 'Activity configuration saved successfully and available in Activity Master List' (HTTP 201).
Opening an existing activity disables the Activity Type radio group; changes on Save show 'Activity configuration updated successfully'.

conflicts.description: ux-image shows a 'Set Template' footer button and dr-page has a full narrative 'Set Template Operation' section (SMS/Email/Line OA template fields, char limits, preview), but item-desc UI_Components/UI_Events has no corresponding rows.
conflicts.resolution: Excluded from this task's scope per developer-decision-001.

conflicts.description: dr-page text lists Call, Email, SMS; item-desc CMP-WCRM010301-018 behavior note lists Email, TMT LON; ux-image sample rows show Email, SMS.
conflicts.resolution: Call, Email, SMS confirmed authoritative per developer-decision-002.

conflicts.description: dr-page text and ux-image show only Service Follow-up; item-desc CMP-WCRM010301-017 behavior note says the dropdown also loads Appointment Confirmation.
conflicts.resolution: Service Follow-up only confirmed authoritative per developer-decision-003.

conflicts.description: dr-page general validation text states -30 to 30; item-desc CMP-WCRM010301-019 behavior note specifies per-process ranges (-1 to -30 for Service Followup/Appointment Confirmation; 1 to 30 for Contact Process).
conflicts.resolution: -30 to 30 flat range confirmed authoritative per developer-decision-004.

conflicts.topic: 'Activity Name' validation bullet with no corresponding field
conflicts.description: dr-page's Validations (Frontend Check) list and CMP-WCRM010301-022 (Save) behavior note both mention an 'Activity Name' field requirement, but item-desc UI_Components has no Activity Name row for WCRM010301 (this text appears to be carried over from the sibling WCRM010203 Activity Setup screen, which does have Activity Name/Customer Type fields).
conflicts.resolution: No Activity Name field is implemented since none exists in the authoritative field list (fields[]). The corresponding validation bullet is not implemented. Not re-litigated with the developer since ui-contract.json fields[] already omitted this field correctly.

openQuestions.description: No structured Screen Mode table was found. Add/Update modes are inferred from narrative page.md sections (Add Operation, Update Record) and EVT_WCRM010301_10. Non-blocking.

No Access Control table was found. dr-page only states Add/Delete/Save are 'enabled based on user permissions' without naming roles or permission codes. Non-blocking for UI contract; permission-gating implementation detail is unresolved.

API_Data_Map_Details_* workbook (endpoint paths, HTTP methods, request/response schemas) is missing. Only API IDs (API-WCRM010301-001..005) and field-to-column mappings are known from data-map. Service layer implementation will need this before build. Non-blocking for the UI contract.

The other 8 Activity Type radios (Additional Rejected Job, DCM Vehicle, TCFR+, SSC/SCS, Body & Paint, BP Insurance Renewal, Upload, PSFU) are visible on the shared screen but this DR (titled '- PM') only defines Periodic Maintenance behavior. Selecting another radio's downstream behavior is out of scope for this Function Key. Non-blocking; visible-only per catalog UX evidence.

The exact copy for the 'unsaved changes' warning shown when switching Activity Type (CMP-WCRM010301-001 behavior note) is not specified anywhere in the DR/item-desc/data-map (only that a warning must appear). A neutral, non-business-rule placeholder message is used pending copy sign-off. All other dialog/toast copy (save confirm, update confirm, save/delete success and failure messages) is DR-specified verbatim. Non-blocking.
